description: Scenario: high-volume auth-scanning bot cycles through a large number of source IPs. auth_limiter.rs::record_failure calls evict_oldest when the tracker is at max_entries capacity. evict_oldest performs a full HashMap iteration to find the minimum-timestamp entry, O(n) in max_entries. With max_entries=10000 this is 10k comparisons per new-IP insertion under sustained scanning. Replace HashMap with a structure that supports O(log n) min extraction, such as a BTreeMap keyed by (timestamp, ip) or a min-heap.
title: AuthFailureTracker::evict_oldest is O(n) scan on every new-IP insert at capacity
